calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
quarterly AS (
    -- as-is: region from the current store version (Online = the web shop, its own line)
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS q3_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS q3_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM quarterly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN quarterly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-10-27' AS ty_start, DATE '2026-01-25' AS ty_end,
           DATE '2024-10-28' AS ly_start, DATE '2025-01-26' AS ly_end
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26 Q3' AS period, SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.ty_start AND params.ty_end
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FY2024/25 Q3' AS period, SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.ly_start AND params.ly_end;
